# Japan Travel by NAVITIME

> > Comprehensive Japan travel platform providing transit search, route planning, itinerary tools, and destination guides for exploring Japan's cities, landmarks, and transportation systems.

Japan Travel by NAVITIME is a specialized travel planning service focused on navigating Japan's complex transportation network, including bullet trains (Shinkansen), local railways, and various rail passes like the JAPAN RAIL PASS and JR KYUSHU RAIL PASS. The platform covers major destinations such as Tokyo, Kyoto, Mt. Fuji, and regional attractions, offering both transit routing and comprehensive travel guides for tourists visiting Japan.

## Key Topics

- NAVITIME
- Japan transit search
- Route planning and itinerary tools
- JAPAN RAIL PASS
- Shinkansen (bullet train)
- Tokyo and Kyoto destinations
- Mt. Fuji and Kawaguchiko
- Narita Airport access
- Railway pass information
- Trip planning for Japan
- Sightseeing guides
- Transportation finder
- Train schedules
- Tourism booking platform

## Core Platform Features

- [Japan Travel by NAVITIME - Japan Travel Guides, Transit Search and Itinerary Planner](https://japantravel.navitime.com/en/): Homepage for NAVITIME's Japan travel planning platform with guides & booking
- [Japan Route Finder & Planner](https://japantravel.navitime.com/en/area/jp/route/): Route finder for Japan transit including bullet trains & railway passes
